question: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?
nl2_rewrite: ### Source & Joins - Source: 'patient' - Link 'patient.ID' (INT) to 'laboratory.ID' (INT) ### Filters - Keep only patients where 'patient.Diagnosis' (TEXT) = 'SJS' ### Aggregation & Computation - Identify the oldest SJS patient by selecting the minimum (earliest) 'patient.Birthday' (DATE) (because smaller birthday value implies older person per Evidence) - If multiple patients share the same minimum 'patient.Birthday' (DATE), keep all such tied oldest patients - For the oldest patient(s), determine the medical laboratory work completion date as the maximum (latest) 'laboratory.Date' (DATE) - Calculate age at initial hospital arrival for the oldest patient(s) as: (year part of 'patient.First Date' (DATE)) − (year part of 'patient.Birthday' (DATE)) ### Return - Medical laboratory work completion date: maximum 'laboratory.Date' (DATE) for the oldest SJS patient(s) - calculated age at initial hospital arrival: (year part of 'patient.First Date' (DATE)) − (year part of 'patient.Birthday' (DATE))
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation错误：需求要求对“最年长SJS患者(最小Birthday，含并列)”整体计算其laboratory.Date的最大值并返回一次结果；SQL却按age_at_initial_arrival进行GROUP BY，导致若并列最年长患者的年龄计算结果不同会返回多行，且MAX(l.Date)被分组后不再是对所有最年长患者的整体最大值。
original_executable_sql: SELECT   MAX(l.`Date`) AS lab_work_completion_date,   (YEAR(p.`First Date`) - YEAR(p.`Birthday`)) AS age_at_initial_arrival FROM `patient` AS p JOIN `laboratory` AS l   ON p.`ID` = l.`ID` WHERE p.`Diagnosis` = 'SJS'   AND p.`Birthday` = (     SELECT MIN(p2.`Birthday`)     FROM `patient` AS p2     WHERE p2.`Diagnosis` = 'SJS'   ) GROUP BY (YEAR(p.`First Date`) - YEAR(p.`Birthday`));
fixed_sql: SELECT   MAX(l.`Date`) AS lab_work_completion_date,   MIN(YEAR(p.`First Date`) - YEAR(p.`Birthday`)) AS age_at_initial_arrival FROM `patient` AS p JOIN `laboratory` AS l   ON p.`ID` = l.`ID` WHERE p.`Diagnosis` = 'SJS'   AND p.`Birthday` = (     SELECT MIN(p2.`Birthday`)     FROM `patient` AS p2     WHERE p2.`Diagnosis` = 'SJS'   );

question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?

unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分未完全实现：需求要求在HGB等于最大值的行中选取对应的laboratory.Date与laboratory.ID（可能多行），再据此计算年龄；SQL仅用WHERE匹配最大HGB后直接LIMIT 1，未保证按需求返回所有最大值对应行，也未显式选取laboratory.Date与laboratory.ID。

question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
nl2_rewrite: ### Source & Joins - Source: 'player_attributes' - Link 'player_attributes.player_api_id' (INT) to 'player.player_api_id' (INT) ### Filters - Keep rows where 'player_attributes.sprint_speed' (INT) >= 97 - Keep rows where the year part of 'player_attributes.date' (TEXT) >= 2013 AND <= 2015 ### Aggregation & Computation - For each qualifying row, compute 'age_at_present' as the difference between the current date-time and 'player.birthday' (TEXT), expressed in years (per Evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((DATETIME(), birthday))) ### Return - Distinct age_at_present
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分不一致：需求要求以当前日期时间(DATETIME())与birthday计算年龄（年），SQL使用CURDATE()仅取日期不含时间；此外SQL额外添加了LIMIT 1000，需求未要求限制返回行数。
original_executable_sql: SELECT DISTINCT        TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, `p`.`birthday`, CURDATE()) AS `age_at_present` FROM `player_attributes` AS `pa` JOIN `player` AS `p`   ON `pa`.`player_api_id` = `p`.`player_api_id` WHERE `pa`.`sprint_speed` >= 97   AND YEAR(`pa`.`date`) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 LIMIT 1000;

question: From 2000 to 2005, what percentage of drivers who were born before 1985 and the lap numbers were over 50?
nl2_rewrite: ### Source & Joins - Source: 'races' (to define the 2000–2005 time window) - Link 'races.raceId' (INT) = 'results.raceId' (INT) - Link 'results.driverId' (INT) = 'drivers.driverId' (INT) ### Filters - Keep races where 'races.year' (INT) ≥ 2000 and 'races.year' (INT) ≤ 2005 ### Aggregation & Computation - Define denominator 'total_drivers_2000_2005' = Count of Distinct 'results.driverId' (INT) after applying the race-year filter - Define numerator 'target_drivers' = Count of Distinct 'results.driverId' (INT) where: - year part of 'drivers.dob' (DATE) < 1985 - 'results.laps' (INT) > 50 - and within the same race-year filter (2000–2005) - Compute 'percentage' = ('target_drivers' / 'total_drivers_2000_2005') * 100 ### Return - percentage
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation错误：分子条件应为 results.laps > 50，但SQL写成了 r.laps > 50（r为results别名，laps字段应来自results而非races）；同时SQL在CASE中使用了 r.driverId（results别名）虽可用，但需求明确为Count Distinct results.driverId，需确保字段来源一致。
original_executable_sql: SELECT   ROUND(     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE       WHEN YEAR(d.`dob`) < 1985 AND r.`laps` > 50 THEN r.`driverId`       ELSE NULL     END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.`driverId`), 0) * 100   , 2) AS `percentage` FROM `races` AS ra JOIN `results` AS r   ON ra.`raceId` = r.`raceId` JOIN `drivers` AS d   ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId` WHERE ra.`year` BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;
fixed_sql: SELECT   ROUND(     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE       WHEN YEAR(d.`dob`) < 1985 AND r.`laps` > 50 THEN r.`driverId`       ELSE NULL     END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.`driverId`), 0) * 100   , 2) AS `percentage` FROM `races` AS ra JOIN `results` AS r   ON ra.`raceId` = r.`raceId` JOIN `drivers` AS d   ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId` WHERE ra.`year` BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

s.consumption_2012) AS increase,     ROUND(       (s.consumption_2013 - s.consumption_2012) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.consumption_2013, 0) * 100,       2     ) AS percentage_increase,     CASE       WHEN ROUND((s.consumption_2013 - s.consumption_2012) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.consumption_2013, 0) * 100, 2) =            (SELECT MAX(x.percentage_increase)             FROM (               SELECT                 ROUND(                   (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - s.consumption_2012) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.consumption_2013, 0) * 100, 2) =            (SELECT MIN(x.percentage_increase)             FROM (               SELECT                 ROUND(                   (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -                    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)                   ) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100,                   2                 ) AS percentage_increase               FROM yearmonth ym               JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID               WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')                 AND c.Currency = 'EUR'                 AND SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) IN ('2012','2013')               GROUP BY c.Segment             ) AS x)       THEN 'lowest'       ELSE NULL     END AS extreme_type   FROM (     SELECT       c.Segment AS segment,       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013     FROM yearmonth ym     JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID     WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')       AND c.Currency = 'EUR'       AND SUBSTR(ym.`Date`, 1, 4) IN ('2012','2013')     GROUP BY c.Segment   ) AS s ) AS t WHERE t.extreme_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FIELD(t.extreme_type, 'biggest', 'lowest') LIMIT 2;

question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
nl2_rewrite: ### Source & Joins - Source: 'transactions_1k' to identify the customer. - Source: 'yearmonth' to retrieve yearly consumption values. - Link 'transactions_1k.CustomerID' (INT) = 'yearmonth.CustomerID' (INT). ### Filters - Identify the target customer as any 'transactions_1k.CustomerID' (INT) having a transaction where: - 'transactions_1k.Date' (DATE) = 2012-08-25 (interpreting the user date 2012/8/25 as 2012-08-25) - 'transactions_1k.Price' (DOUBLE) = 634.8 - For that identified customer, restrict consumption rows in 'yearmonth' to years 2012 and 2013 by using the year part of 'yearmonth.Date' (VARCHAR): - year('yearmonth.Date' (VARCHAR)) = 2012 OR year('yearmonth.Date' (VARCHAR)) = 2013 ### Aggregation & Computation - Compute 'consumption_2012' as the total (sum) of 'yearmonth.Consumption' (DOUBLE) for the identified customer where year('yearmonth.Date' (VARCHAR)) = 2012. - Compute 'consumption_2013' as the total (sum) of 'yearmonth.Consumption' (DOUBLE) for the identified customer where year('yearmonth.Date' (VARCHAR)) = 2013. - Compute 'consumption_decrease_rate' = ('consumption_2012' - 'consumption_2013') / 'consumption_2012' (per Evidence definition). ### Return - consumption_decrease_rate
unimplemented_reason: Return部分不完全一致：需求要求返回consumption_decrease_rate（针对“该”目标客户），但SQL在子查询中按CustomerID分组后使用LIMIT 1任意取一条；当存在多个满足transactions_1k条件的CustomerID时，结果不确定，未严格实现“识别目标客户并返回其消费下降率”的要求。
original_executable_sql: SELECT   (t.consumption_2012 - t.consumption_2013) / NULLIF(t.consumption_2012, 0) AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM (   SELECT     ym.CustomerID,     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ym.`Date`) = 2012 THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ym.`Date`) = 2013 THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013   FROM yearmonth AS ym   WHERE ym.CustomerID IN (     SELECT tr.CustomerID     FROM transactions_1k AS tr     WHERE tr.`Date` = '2012-08-25'       AND tr.Price = 634.8   )     AND YEAR(ym.`Date`) IN (2012, 2013)   GROUP BY ym.CustomerID ) AS t LIMIT 1;
fixed_sql: SELECT   (t.consumption_2012 - t.consumption_2013) / NULLIF(t.consumption_2012, 0) AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM (   SELECT     tr.CustomerID,     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(ym.`Date`, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2012 THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,     SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(ym.`Date`, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2013 THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013   FROM (     SELECT MIN(CustomerID) AS CustomerID     FROM transactions_1k     WHERE `Date` = '2012-08-25'       AND Price = 634.8   ) AS tr   JOIN yearmonth AS ym     ON ym.CustomerID = tr.CustomerID   WHERE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(ym.`Date`, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (2012, 2013)   GROUP BY tr.CustomerID ) AS t;

question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
nl2_rewrite: ### Source & Joins - Source: 'cards' - Link 'cards.uuid' (VARCHAR(256)) = 'rulings.uuid' (VARCHAR(256)) ### Aggregation & Computation - For each card, compute 'ruling_count' = Count of 'rulings.uuid' (VARCHAR(256)) - Identify the maximum 'ruling_count' across all cards ("most ruling information" refers to Max(Count('rulings.uuid' (VARCHAR(256)))) ) - Keep only the card(s) whose 'ruling_count' equals this maximum - Derive promotional printing label from 'cards.isPromo' (INT): - If 'cards.isPromo' (INT) = 1, promotional printing = 'YES' - If 'cards.isPromo' (INT) = 1, promotional printing = 'NO' ### Return - 'cards.name' (TEXT) as Card Name - 'cards.artist' (TEXT) as Artist Name - promotional printing (YES or NO)
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation错误：需求要求以cards为粒度统计ruling_count=Count(rulings.uuid)并取最大值；SQL实际在子查询中按rulings.uuid分组计数COUNT(*)，且未以cards为分组主体，语义上不等同于“对每张卡统计其rulings记录数”。此外，需求说明书中促销标记规则写成isPromo=1同时对应YES和NO（自相矛盾），SQL采用ELSE 'NO'，无法严格满足该验收标准。
original_executable_sql: SELECT   c.name AS `Card Name`,   c.artist AS `Artist Name`,   CASE WHEN c.isPromo = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS `promotional printing` FROM `cards` AS c JOIN (   SELECT     r.uuid,     COUNT(*) AS ruling_count   FROM `rulings` AS r   GROUP BY r.uuid ) AS rc   ON c.uuid = rc.uuid WHERE rc.ruling_count = (   SELECT MAX(t.ruling_count)   FROM (     SELECT       r2.uuid,       COUNT(*) AS ruling_count     FROM `rulings` AS r2     GROUP BY r2.uuid   ) AS t );
fixed_sql: SELECT   c.name AS `Card Name`,   c.artist AS `Artist Name`,   CASE     WHEN c.isPromo = 1 THEN 'YES'     WHEN c.isPromo = 1 THEN 'NO'     ELSE 'NO'   END AS `promotional printing` FROM `cards` AS c JOIN `rulings` AS r   ON c.uuid = r.uuid GROUP BY   c.uuid,   c.name,   c.artist,   c.isPromo HAVING COUNT(r.uuid) = (   SELECT MAX(t.ruling_count)   FROM (     SELECT       c2.uuid,       COUNT(r2.uuid) AS ruling_count     FROM `cards` AS c2     JOIN `rulings` AS r2       ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid     GROUP BY c2.uuid   ) AS t );
